sources.publication_date: Not stated on the reviewed page
sources.geographic_coverage: Statewide network; listed Ernakulam NAMP stations only are shown here
sources.schema_crs_units: Station name, monitoring zone and program transcribed from page; no coordinates, measurements, CRS, pollutant units, or time-series schema
sources.evidence: KSPCB's ambient-monitoring page lists four Ernakulam industrial stations (Irumpanam, Eloor, Kalamessery, Udyogamandal), two commercial stations (M.G. Road, Vytilla) and Ernakulam South as residential. It describes NAMP/SAMP as manual monitoring; the KSPCB IPAM page states 8–11 monitoring days per month and gives pollutant-specific sampling durations.
sources.reuse_status: The page is public and copyrighted by KSPCB; dataset-specific open reuse terms were not located. This record retains only a source-linked station-name inventory and does not redistribute measurements.
sources.blocker: KSPCB e-library and report listing are public, but the e-library returned HTTP 502 in web retrieval and direct workspace HTTPS requests failed before an HTTP response. The IPAM page describes monitoring parameters/cadence but the reviewed render did not provide a dated downloadable Kochi observation table or dataset-level reuse terms.

sources.publisher: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), Government of India; hosted on OGD India
sources.geographic_coverage: National real-time monitoring stations; Kochi-specific downloadable records not obtained
sources.schema_crs_units: Catalog describes AQI and monitored pollutants SO2, NO2, PM10, PM2.5, CO and O3 among others; resource schema, station coordinate CRS, observation units/averaging metadata were not retrievable from the public catalog render
sources.evidence: The official OGD catalog attributes the resource to CPCB and MoEFCC, says it provides real-time National AQI from monitoring stations, and labels it released under NDSAP. The page links to an API-details page whose visible action is Generate API Key; the catalog page has no downloadable observation rows.
sources.reuse_status: Catalog states NDSAP; the portal footer states the Government Open Data License-India applies to published datasets/resources. Resource data could not be retrieved to verify its specific schema or any resource-level conditions.
sources.blocker: API details require API-key generation. No credential is available in the workspace, and the public catalog exposes no raw observation file or rows; no API request was made with an unavailable key.

sources.publisher: Kerala State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB), IPAM air-quality dashboard
sources.publication_date: Year labels 2023-2026; exact aggregation cutoffs are not stated
sources.geographic_coverage: Statewide; 130 station summary rows downloaded for 2023-2026, including Ernakulam stations
sources.schema_crs_units: Station code, station name, monitoring mode and source-reported average_aqi (unitless); no coordinates, pollutant concentrations, observation timestamps, or completeness metadata
sources.evidence: Public GET endpoint returned 130 statewide year-labeled AQI summary rows for 2023-2026. Requests for 2015-2022 returned empty station lists. Nine rows match the documented NAMP reference stations after case/punctuation/spacing normalization and matching the monitoring program. The processed copy is data/processed/air_quality/kspcb_annual_aqi.csv; raw responses and SHA-256 metadata are stored under data/raw/air_quality/.
sources.reuse_status: Dataset-specific reuse terms were not located; the KSPCB portal states copyright. This project retains source attribution and original downloaded payloads.
sources.blocker: This annual endpoint provides only year-labeled average_aqi and no pollutant-specific values or exact period cutoff. Separate KSPCB daily/monthly reports have now supplied historical dated readings; the latest/live dashboard request still returned HTTP 403.

sources.publisher: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), National AQI method
sources.publication_date: Not stated in the reviewed PDF
sources.schema_crs_units: AQI method: 24-hour averages for most pollutants, 8-hour for CO/O3; minimum three pollutants including PM2.5 or PM10 and at least 16 hours of data for sub-index
sources.evidence: CPCB states that the highest pollutant sub-index is the AQI and that individual sub-indices can be disseminated when the overall AQI data requirement is not met.
sources.reuse_status: Official public methodology document; linked for attribution and method reference.
sources.blocker: CPCB methodology is documented. KSPCB reports now supply dated station values, but exact per-pollutant averaging and completeness fields are absent in the available reports, so this project does not recalculate AQI or identify a driving pollutant.

sources.publisher: Kerala State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB), daily average AQI report
sources.geographic_coverage: KSPCB CAAQMS stations shown in the report; five rows with AQI and pollutant values, four rows marked insufficient data or power failure
sources.schema_crs_units: Station labels, report date, AQI, source remark, nine pollutant concentrations and units. Exact pollutant averaging intervals, station identifiers, coordinates, and completeness flags are not printed.
sources.evidence: The one-page report gives source-reported daily AQI and concentrations for Eloor, Plamood, Karyavattom, Kannur, and Thrissur. Palayam, M.G. Road, and Vytilla are marked insufficient data; Kollam is marked power failure. Parsed rows and station status are in data/processed/air_quality/kspcb_daily_aqi_2026-10-16.csv and kspcb_daily_aqi_status_2026-10-16.csv. Original PDF and SHA-256 are preserved under data/raw/air_quality_reports/.
sources.reuse_status: No report-specific open licence identified; source is attributed to KSPCB and retained for project research. Confirm redistribution terms before republication.
sources.blocker: This is one historical report date and not a live feed. Pollutant averaging periods/completeness are not stated, so no CPCB sub-index or driver is calculated.

sources.publisher: Kerala State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB), CAAQMS monthly report
sources.geographic_coverage: Five CAAQMS station pages statewide; one Ernakulam page for Eloor
sources.schema_crs_units: Eloor page has 31 date rows, nine pollutant concentrations with units, AQI, wind speed/direction and weather values. Exact averaging interval, station code/coordinates and row-level completeness/QC not stated.
sources.evidence: The Eloor monthly page provides 31 daily pollutant-value rows, 31 source-reported AQI values, wind speed and direction. The normalized pollutant table contains 279 rows; AQI and weather tables contain 31 rows each. Extracts are in data/processed/air_quality/ and source hashes are in kspcb_air_reports.metadata.json.
sources.reuse_status: No dataset-specific licence identified; source is attributed to KSPCB and retained for project research. Confirm redistribution terms before republication.
sources.blocker: Exact pollutant averaging duration and completeness/capture flags are not printed for Eloor. Only one Ernakulam CAAQMS station is included in this report, so a Kochi station comparison is unavailable.

sources.publisher: Kerala State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB), NAMP report
sources.publication_date: Directory entry says August 2025; Ernakulam report pages say June 2025; retrieved 2026-10-23
sources.geographic_coverage: Eight Ernakulam report stations; 62 dated station samples
sources.schema_crs_units: Station codes, source labels, dates, latitude/longitude, locality fields, SO2/NO2/RSPM time-window values and 24-hour averages, PM2.5 values, temperature/weather and some explicit missing markers. Pollutant units and CRS are not stated.
sources.evidence: Ernakulam pages contain 62 dated station rows for June 2025 across eight station codes. Raw-field extract is data/processed/air_quality/kspcb_namp_ernakulam_2025-06.csv. * markers are retained. Kuttippadam coordinates vary across rows.
sources.reuse_status: No dataset-specific licence identified; source is attributed to KSPCB and retained for project research. Confirm redistribution terms before republication.
sources.blocker: Pollutant concentration units and coordinate reference system are absent from the reviewed PDF. Do not use the values for trends or AQI until units are verified. Report entry month conflicts with page content.

sources.publisher: Kerala Water Authority (KWA), Edayar CETP report and source page
sources.publication_date: Report prepared August 2021 and approved 2022-06-01; current KWA page retrieved 2026-10-23
sources.geographic_coverage: Edayar industrial estate / Eloor-Edayar industrial belt
sources.schema_crs_units: Eight named major Edayar industries; estate-level coordinate; estate-level industrial type counts and historical treated-effluent permissions. No company-specific coordinates or air-emission measurements.
sources.evidence: The KWA DER names CMRL, Sud-cheme India, Arjuna Natural Extracts, TMS Leathers, Active Char Product, Indo German Carbon, Rubber O Malabar Products, and Malaya Rub Tech as major industries. It says CMRL, TMS Leathers and Sud-Cheme had treated-effluent discharge authorization to Periyar as of the report. The current KWA page gives estate-level industry-type counts.
sources.reuse_status: No document-specific open licence identified; retain KWA attribution and confirm redistribution terms.
sources.blocker: Effluent planning data are not air emissions. The source provides no individual coordinates, pollutant emissions, stack profiles or current air consent validity.

sources.publisher: Directorate of Industries and Commerce, Government of Kerala
sources.publication_date: DWG metadata date 2021-05-25; listing page dated 2022-01-15 and last modified 2026-09-29
sources.schema_crs_units: AutoCAD plot/survey drawing. No named-facility-to-plot link or CRS was verified.
sources.evidence: Official listing links DA Edayar to a DWG file, preserved under data/raw/industrial/. Directorate Ernakulam infrastructure page (dated 2022-01-10) reports 264 working units in the Development Area.
sources.reuse_status: Directorate page carries a copyright policy; no dataset-specific open licence identified.
sources.blocker: No compatible CAD reader was available to verify plot labels or join named firms to plots. No facility coordinates are derived from this map.

sources.publisher: Kerala State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB), CAAQMS monthly report
sources.geographic_coverage: Eloor CAAQMS report page, Ernakulam; September 2026

sources.publisher: Directorate of Industries and Commerce, Government of Kerala
sources.geographic_coverage: Edayar industrial development area; historical plot allotment register
sources.schema_crs_units: Published business names, plot identifiers and plot areas as printed. Plot identifiers are not coordinates.
sources.evidence: PDF signature, byte count and SHA-256 match sidecar; sidecar records 30 pages, 52,159 extracted text characters and Edayar/allotment markers.
sources.reuse_status: No document-specific open licence identified; retain attribution and confirm terms before redistribution.

not_obtained: Exact per-pollutant averaging intervals and completeness/quality flags for the acquired CAAQMS daily values
Concentration units for the June 2025 NAMP observations; those rows are preserved but excluded from analysis
A stated coordinate reference system for NAMP station coordinates and verified firm-level facility coordinates
Current facility-level air consent certificates, emission limits, stack tests or pollutant source signatures
Hour-aligned meteorology, background pollution and a competing-source inventory for potential-source analysis
Dataset-specific reuse/licence terms for the KSPCB and KWA report documents
interpretation_limit: AQI indicates an air-quality concern but does not identify its source. The Edayar facility list is a candidate inventory only. Do not infer causation from industrial-estate presence, proximity, AQI, or wind direction alone. The legacy data/raw/air_pollution_data.csv remains an undocumented illustrative sample and is not analyzed.
